# A modpack with wonderful RPG mods and other nice things

This modpack blends thrilling RPG exploration with powerful Create industrial progression and handy quality-of-life enhancements. Discover vast worlds filled with dungeons, quests, and mythical creatures, while building advanced machinery to fuel your survival

## Main features of modpack

### 🏹 RPG & Adventure
- Alex’s Caves, Caverns & Chasms, Valoria, Environmental – Expansive underground and overworld exploration with new biomes, structures, and progression paths.
- Alex’s Mobs, Cryptic Foes, Dweller Dweller, Just Orcs, Wizard’s Reborn – Adds diverse creatures, bosses, and fantasy races for combat and lore depth.
- Unusual Prehistory 2, Upgrade Aquatic, Endergetic Expansion, Galosphere – Expands dimensions and ecosystems with prehistoric, aquatic, and end-themed content.
### ⚙️ Creativity & Engineering
- Create – Mechanical automation, contraptions, and kinetic builds.
- Create Addons:
- Create Crafts & Additions – Electrical systems and new machines.
- Create Slice & Dice – Farming automation.
- Create Deco – Decorative machinery blocks.
- Create Big Cannons – Large-scale weaponry.
- Create: Structures Overhaul – Worldgen integration with Create structures.
### 🍲 Farming & Lifestyle
- Farmer’s Delight, Brewin’ & Chewin’, BlockDonald’s Delight, Bread Reborn, Galospheric Delight, Neapolitan, Crispy Fish – Rich cooking, brewing, and food variety.
- Clayworks, AppleSkin, Backpets – Utility farming, hunger visualization, and pet backpacks.
### 🎨 Quality of Life & Immersion
- Mouse Tweaks, Not Enough Animations, Falling Blocks Anim, AppleSkin, JEI (Just Enough Items) – UI and gameplay improvements.
- Moonlight Lib, Ritchie’s Projectile Library, The Sham, Shershavy, Amendments – Backend libraries and small enhancements ensuring compatibility and polish.
- Supplementaries, Quark, Cryptic Foes, Environmental – Decorative blocks, tweaks, and immersive worldbuilding.
